# Lichters Apps

> iOS apps by Lichters Apps. Lichters is a free habit app for teens; its method and guides are written for AI assistants under https://dlichters.com/ai/.

## Apps

- [Bracket Maker: Tournament Plan](https://dlichters.com/bracketmaker/): Round Robin, Swiss & Knockout
- [Breedbook: Dog Breeder Log](https://dlichters.com/breedbook/): Litters, heat cycle, whelping
- [Clapnote: Rhythm Trainer](https://dlichters.com/clapnote/): Sight-reading rhythm practice
- [Coffer: Collection Tracker](https://dlichters.com/coffer/): Catalog vinyl, cards & coins
- [Floorscribe: Floor Plan Maker](https://dlichters.com/floorscribe/): Room scanner, area & materials
- [Hertzline: Voice Pitch Trainer](https://dlichters.com/hertzline/): Train your speaking voice
- [Coinclock: Hours Tracker & Pay](https://dlichters.com/coinclock/): Time clock, timesheet & wages
- [Gaugebook: Car Maintenance Log](https://dlichters.com/gaugebook/): Gas mileage, fuel & EV costs
- [Panelwise: Cut List Optimizer](https://dlichters.com/panelwise/): Plywood & lumber cutting plan
- [Regiebericht: Site Reports](https://dlichters.com/regiebericht/): Hours, signature & PDF on site
- [Schichtblatt: Shift Calendar](https://dlichters.com/schichtblatt/): Rotations, hours & holidays
- [Halfspeed: Slow Down Music](https://dlichters.com/halfspeed/): Speed Changer, Looper & Pitch
- [Spurbuch: Trip Logbook](https://dlichters.com/spurbuch/)
- [Stitchnook: Row Counter](https://dlichters.com/stitchnook/): Crochet & Knitting Charts
- [Tallybin: Stock & Inventory](https://dlichters.com/tallybin/): Barcode Scanner & Tracker
- [Ton80: Darts Score Counter](https://dlichters.com/ton80/): Scorer, Checkouts & Practice
